lightning_totem.name: Lightning Totem
lightning_totem.description: Calls down lightning during a storm... Use with care! Consumed on use.
storm_totem.name: Storm Totem
storm_totem.description: Activate to greatly increase the chance for storms tomorrow. Consumed on use.
protected_area_caption: The totem crumbles... but a strange force shields this place from its magic.
lightning_totem_applied: Over your head, you can feel the air charged with electricity...
farm_only_caption: This can only be used on the Farm.
rain_only_caption: This only works on rainy days.
gmcm.unlock_recipe.description: Enable the recipes for the totems along with the Rain Totem recipe in the vanilla game (if disabled, the totems can still be obtained through other means, but their recipes won't be available).
gmcm.lightning_behavior.description: Adjust how all lightning behaves during storms (not just that from the Lightning Totem). By default, lucky weather keeps strikes rare on trees and crops.
gmcm.safe_lightning.tooltip: If enabled, lightning will absolutely not strike trees or crops.
gmcm.unsafe_lightning.tooltip: If enabled, lightning might strike trees and crops regardless of the player's luck.
gmcm.lightning_totem_section.tooltip: Configure the behavior of the Lightning Totem.
gmcm.easteregg_probability.tooltip: Set to 1 to guarantee a surprise! Set to 0 to disable it.
gmcm.max_lightning.tooltip: The maximum number of lightning strikes that can be triggered by a single Lightning Totem. About half hit instantly, the rest arrive gradually.
gmcm.manual_trigger_keys.tooltip: The keys to trigger lightning flashes.
gmcm.debug_enable.tooltip: If enabled, you can trigger small and big flashes with the configured keys.
gmcm.small_flash.tooltip: The key to trigger a small flash.
gmcm.big_flash.tooltip: The key to trigger a big flash.
